evidence: bp-app.lisp:237 `(path (fnn-bp-evidence-publish tally :accepted wire adu))` runs inside the :accepted arm, before fnn-bpapp-accept-locked. Lines 260-267 then return `(list :refused app-result)` or `(list :uncertain app-result)` for class :refused, :deferred or other.
fix: Decide the application outcome first, then publish evidence with the final verdict (:accepted, :refused or :uncertain plus the reason), or publish the wire alone first and the verdict sidecar after the decision.
reviewer: bp-app.lisp:237 publishes an :accepted evidence verdict with the ADU inside the :accepted arm, before fnn-owner-transit-serialized and fnn-bpapp-accept-locked decide. Lines 260-266 then return (:refused ...) or (:uncertain ...) to TCPCL. Immutable evidence (fnn-bp-evidence-publish, bp.lisp:334) therefore records accepted for a transfer the session refused or fenced. That is the BP-decode verdict, not the transfer outcome. This is an evidence mismatch, not a custody loss.
scenario: A bundle decodes but the owner plan refuses it (untrusted principal, :busy deferral) or is uncertain. The immutable evidence namespace permanently holds an `accepted` verdict sidecar with the ADU for a transfer the session refused or fenced. The evidence that replays and interop vectors rely on disagrees with the outcome actually returned and counted.
title: bp-app records an :accepted receive verdict before the application decides, then refuses or reports uncertain
